title: 孕妇·伸手接取·同身份完整纸件

source.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One complete reusable paper-theatre pose. Reference is exact identity and style master. Keep same Chinese pregnant woman, dark hair in bun, mustard cardigan, off-white maternity shirt over clearly coherent pregnant belly, teal trousers, cream flat shoes, same pregnancy stage and natural balance; preserve face, age, hairstyle, body proportions, garments and shoes. Change only pose to standing balanced three-quarter facing screen right; image-right hand extended at waist height with open upward palm ready to receive a separate document; other hand relaxed, or resting under pregnant belly where relevant; no document or prop. Natural connected complete anatomy, same tactile paper-cut illustration, opaque interior and clean edges. Entire hair/head, visible hands, legs and shoes in frame with generous margin. Single isolated figure, GENUINE transparent background. No chair, environment, floor mark, cast shadow, glow/aura, gradient/vignette, checkerboard, text/logo or props. Do not infantilize older adults or shrink adult anatomy into a child.

usage_notes: 完整人物单幅姿态，接触与当前景别需要试装；手按画面左右，锚点用于试装，不代表可以持握任意物件。按同一人物的头身比例配准，不按PNG外框统一高度。
